title: start_vision_session
description: An administrator opened a remote-control session (POST /api/audit/session/start). Non-mandatory: the user is asked and may decline (`vision_rejected`). Mandatory: the user is told, after `countdown_seconds`. Once approved the agent opens the Vision channel and streams `stream_frame`s. Refused with `capability_denied` when Vision is off.

is_mandatory.description: True: no consent dialog (a reason is required).

admin_name.description: Panel user shown to the user.

requested_by.description: 0.1.12+. Same as `admin_name`; written to the local audit log.

countdown_seconds.description: Mandatory sessions: 30 (5 when the device is quarantined); 0 otherwise.

fps.description: Frames per second to start with; not sent by the server, the Windows tray uses 2.
